北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 多云有风，体感 15℃。早晚凉，记得加衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and breezy, feels like 15℃. Remember to dress warmly in mornings and evenings!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感 12℃，湿度高。出门别忘带伞，注意保暖！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, feels like 12℃ with high humidity. Don't forget an umbrella and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨 15℃，体感微凉。记得带伞，小心路滑哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Light rain, 15℃, feels a bit cool. Remember your umbrella and watch your step.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感 31℃，湿度大。注意防暑，多补充水分哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, feels like 31℃ with high humidity. Stay cool and hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感 27℃，湿度较大。出行记得带水，注意防晒。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, feels like 27℃, high humidity. Stay hydrated and mind the sun.
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 今日有雨，体感 16℃。出门带伞，路面湿滑，注意安全。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Rainy day, feels like 16℃. Take your umbrella, roads are wet, stay safe.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨 17℃，体感 14℃。出门别忘带伞，注意添衣哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Light rain, feels like 14℃. Don't forget your umbrella and dress warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感 21℃，气温适中。注意早晚温差，穿衣适宜。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, feels like 21℃. Watch for temp changes morning/evening, dress accordingly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 19℃，湿度 100%。体感潮湿，小心衣物返潮哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, 19℃, 100% humidity. It feels damp, mind your clothes getting humid.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感 16℃，微凉。早晚温差大，记得添衣保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, feels like 16℃. Big temp difference morning/evening, remember to dress warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感 21℃，湿度适中。外出游玩，心情也要美美的。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, feels like 21℃. Moderate humidity. Enjoy your day out!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感 4℃，非常寒冷。请务必多穿衣物，小心着凉！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, feels like 4℃, very cold. Please bundle up and avoid catching a cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 晴天体感 13℃，早晚温差大。注意添衣，保湿很重要。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny, feels like 13℃, large temp difference morning/evening. Dress warm and stay hydrated.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 多云体感 20℃，天气舒适。出行记得防晒，补充水分。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, feels like 20℃, pleasant weather. Remember sunscreen and stay hydrated.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 多云体感 29℃，湿度大。注意防暑，多喝水，小心中暑。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, feels like 29℃ with high humidity. Stay cool, drink water, and prevent heatstroke.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感 14℃，风力 3级。出门添件外套，小心着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, feels like 14℃ with breezy wind. Bring a jacket and avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 多云体感 11℃，早晚温差大。记得添衣，小心感冒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, feels like 11℃, big temp difference morning/evening. Dress warm, avoid colds.
